source.name: Arkansas Oil and Gas Commission wells, via the Arkansas GIS Office (map service)

at_risk.definition: AOGC status Temporarily Abandoned, Inactive or Shut In, with an operator named.

verification_note: Not cross-checked yet: the state file is the only operator source found so far. USGS Arkansas rows are matched on their AOGC permit number (356 of 356); coordinates agree within about 1 m.
notes: The layer has no API column; USGS secondary_identifier 'Permit:NNNN' is joined to permitnumberstring. Only wells with surface coordinates are in this layer.
